subject: help needed to remove quote marks when using renderPrint

messages.author: 86b9bd68069ba200
messages.subject: help needed to remove quote marks when using renderPrint
parts:
I am using renderPrint to display a numeric matrix. Now I am trying to display the numbers as percentage. After pasting "%"to the numbers, for example, numeric 1 is converted to 1%, which is a character string. 

I use renderPrint to display the result, however, instead of showing 1%, it shows "1%". I tried my best to remove/hide the quote marks, unfortunately, I failed.

Could anybody tell me how to remove the quote marks?

Thanks

btw, I use 1% as an example, actually I have matrix to display.
